role: Rewires dispatcherIndex/hook on a SINGLE live NFTStakerDepletion in place (source == target). Parks ERC1155 in own custody across the empty-pool reset, re-injects into the SAME immutable staker. Timeout escape hatch returns parked stake to user.

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: migrateOut loops users[] (onlyOwner); migrateIn is PAGINATED via [start,end) with memory-snapshot-first; parkedUsersRange paginated views

invariants.totalParked: Sum(parked[*]); FLOOR that rescueERC1155(stakedId) can never cross (surplus = balance - totalParked)
invariants.parkedSet: manual swap-remove set (_parkedUsers + 1-based _parkedIndex) - OZ EnumerableSet needs 0.8.24, this targets 0.8.20
invariants.CEI: migrateIn/claimTimedOut zero parked state BEFORE ERC1155 transfer, under nonReentrant

localFindings.description: Timeout hatch (MIN_TIMEOUT 1d) and operator migrateIn can race: a user whose timeout elapsed can claimTimedOut to pull parked stake back to their wallet before the operator re-injects. This is intended (documented escape hatch) - not a bug, but a parked user reclaiming stops re-injection for that user (they must re-stake manually). Prior-run L-01/UBC-02 class: non-atomic resume can leave a user un-rewired. DEFER cross-run reconciliation.
localFindings.recommendation: interaction/script scanner: confirm operator completes migrateIn within timeout window; a claimed-out user is correctly skipped (parked==0 -> continue, no double-pay). Verified: migrateIn skips amt==0 with no revert.

externalEntryPoints.notes: batchMigrate settles+mints phUSD to users and transfers aggregate ERC1155 to this contract; records per-user park + timeout anchor. Idempotent.
requires staker back in Active (owner ran finalizeAndReset + rewire). Snapshot slice first; CEI per user; skips already-claimed (amt==0). Re-injection ONLY into immutable staker.
require parked>0 && now >= migrationBegin+timeout; CEI; returns STAKE ONLY (phUSD already minted at migrateOut).
unconditional ERC20 sweep - parked principal is ERC1155 so structurally untouchable by ERC20 path.
id==stakedId: amount <= balance - totalParked (surplus only, floor-protected); other ids: full balance.

trustAssumptions: operator runs finalizeAndReset + rewire between migrateOut and migrateIn
timeout window sized so operator completes before users claim out
